items.name: L.A.S.S.I
items.info: The trustiest hound to ever roam the village proper, L.A.S.S.I chases enemies with unrelenting fury. Unless they fly, in which case she just observes them intently.

items.name: Mighty Yak
items.info: Built like a Siege Machine, the Mighty Yak has a knack for knocking down any walls it comes in contact with. It also flies into a rage if you knock out its companion.

items.name: Electro Owl
items.info: Electro Owl zaps enemy defenses into dust from great distance. He's mostly made of feathers though, so better keep him well protected!

items.name: Unicorn
items.info: Unicorns have severe trust issues, but overcoming them with love and patience is totally worth it. They'll heal up any minor or major scrapes as well as any Healer!

items.name: Phoenix
items.info: A true friend will egg you on when things get rough. Phoenix starts the battle as a helpless egg, but at the moment her Hero might go down, she hatches. The furious fiery fowl then gives temporary invulnerability to its Hero and engages nearby enemies.

items.name: Poison Lizard
items.info: Always the fastest never the lastest, Poison Lizard spits slowing toxins at its foes. Is it actually a venom lizard? Possibly, but who's brave enough to correct it?

items.name: Diggy
items.info: Diggy is an introvert and spends a lot of time hiding underground. Still, when it comes to battle, he'll do his part, coming up to attack buildings and aid his Hero. If his Hero's taken out, he'll seek out a new one for support and scritches.

items.name: Frosty
items.info: Frosty is the coolest Pet... literally. Not only does his icy breath cause enemies to chill out, but he also releases swarms of Frostmites to further slow down defenses and help his Hero.

items.name: Spirit Fox
items.info: An extremely shy creature who's happiest alone in the woods outside the village. When called to battle, Spirit Fox fights fiercely alongside their Hero and helps them with a little invisibility.

items.name: Angry Jelly
items.info: This blob of pure anger gets impatient waiting around the village, it's hungry for a good fight. During battle, it convinces its Hero to attack defenses before splitting to fight separately.

items.name: Sneezy
items.info: Her nose is blocked and loaded! Sneezy hangs behind her Hero due to allergies and sneezes tanky air Boogers that target buildings. She goes on the attack when her Hero falls!

items.name: Greedy Raven
items.info: No scarecrow is frightening enough to keep Greedy Raven away from shiny loot! This masked bandit’s swift feathers target and deal extra damage to resource buildings and egos.
